# illumio-cloudsecure_policy (Resource)

Manages a policy on CloudSecure.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "illumio-cloudsecure_policy" "vnet_to_vnet" {
  name        = "VNet to VNet"
  description = "Allow traffic between Azure VNets"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name for the CloudSecure policy.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the CloudSecure policy.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) CloudSecure ID.
